ocr_status.description: Whether text recognition is available (its models are installed: release packages include them; a source build fetches them with `cargo xtask models`; PDFCRAFT_MODELS overrides), where it looks for them, and the languages it reads.
ocr_status.name: ocr_status

ocr_recognize.description: Scan & OCR ▸ Recognize text: render pages, read the words in them and add them as invisible text over the page image, so scanned pages become searchable and selectable (a searchable image; the image is not changed). Pages that already have text are skipped unless skip_text_pages is false; then pictures on those pages are read too, and recognised words that the page's own text already has (an earlier OCR layer included) are left out and counted as already_on_page. Returns each page's recognised text, word count or why it was skipped. Needs the OCR models (ocr_status). Undoable as one step.

doc.description: Document id from doc_open or doc_list.

dpi.description: Resolution pages are read at (default 300; a scanned page is read at most at its own resolution).

skip_text_pages.description: Leave pages that already contain text alone (default true). false also reads pictures on such pages, without adding their text again.

ocr_recognize.name: ocr_recognize

text_extract.description: Extract the text of some or all pages, in reading order. With rect, only the text inside that rectangle on each page, as Column select takes it: one row per visual line, side-by-side pieces (table cells) separated by a tab.

doc.description: Document id from doc_open or doc_list.

rect.description: Column select: [x0, y0, x1, y1] in points from the top-left of the displayed page; a glyph counts when its centre is inside.

text_extract.name: text_extract

doc_save.description: Save to its own file (an incremental update, which keeps signatures valid) or to a new path (a full rewrite). The write is atomic. flatten_fill_sign bakes Fill & Sign text, marks and signatures into the page first and removes those annotations; other comments and form fields stay. Omit it, or pass false, to leave them editable.

doc.description: Document id from doc_open or doc_list.

flatten_fill_sign.description: Bake Fill & Sign marks into the page before writing. Default false.

full.description: Force a full rewrite (or, with false, an incremental update).

path.description: Save as this file. Omit to save in place.

doc_save.name: doc_save
